artworks.title: Ferdinand II, Par la Grace de Dieu Emperur des Romains
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to the viewer's left. He wears a decorated outfit with a ruffled collar and a chain. The background features multiple horse riders in a landscape with trees and clouds. The man is identified as Ferdinand II, Emperor of the Romans, with French text at the bottom.

artworks.title: William Fich of Canfield, Essex
artworks.artist: Jacques Picart I or Jacques Picart II
artworks.description: The image shows a monk standing with his hands crossed over his chest in a pose of reverence or prayer. He has a light-colored, closely cropped hairstyle and a well-groomed beard, with a serene expression. The monk is wearing a traditional Capuchin habit with a hood, belted by a rope, and a rosary with a cross hanging from his waist. In the background, there is a wooden cross with a crucifixion scene and flowing text. Beside the monk is a table with an open book, an ink pot with a quill pen, and a skull on top of stacked books. The setting is intricate, with detailed textures in the clothing and objects.

artworks.title: Christopher Fierer
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a half-body portrait. He is facing slightly to the right, looking at the viewer. The man has prominent cheekbones, a broad mustache, and a full beard. He has short, curly hair. He is wearing a dark, patterned tunic with a high collar, a large white ruffled collar, and a layered garment over it. He is holding compasses in his right hand and his left hand rests on a book or papers. The background has a textured pattern, and below the portrait, there is decorative script, text, and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: John Fisher, Bishop of Rochester
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. His hands are visible at the bottom of the image. The man has distinct facial features, with a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, displaying a contemplative expression. He is wearing a snug-fitting cap and a robe with a fur collar. The background has a textured pattern. A name, "IOANNES FISCHERUS EPISC ROFFEN," is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: John Fisher, Bishop of Rochester
artworks.artist: Frans van den Wyngaerde after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn of the head. He has deep-set eyes and prominent facial lines, wears a cap, robe with a fur collar, and a tunic with vertical pleats. The background features an archway design with a wooden texture pattern. An inscription below the portrait includes Latin text and the names "IOANNES FISCHER" and "H. Holbein."

artworks.title: John Fisher and Sir Thomas More
artworks.description: The engraved artwork features two men depicted bust-length, facing slightly toward each other. On the left is Ioannes Roffensis with a lined face and prominent cheekbones, wearing a cap and fur-trimmed robes. On the right is Thomas More, also wearing a cap and fur-lined robe with a decorative chain. The background is a simple texture, emphasizing the figures. Latin text runs across the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Eva Fliegen
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person in a detailed engraving. The person faces forward with hands on a ledge, holding a bouquet of flowers. They have a serious expression, prominent eyebrows, a slender face, a cap, and a fur-lined hood. They wear a high-collared garment. The background features an arch with engravings and inscriptions on top, with verses below in a neat script.

artworks.title: Medallion of Woman's Head: Flora
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sculpted bust of a person with flowing hair. The drawing is centered on the page, with intricate detailing in the hair, which appears to be styled with curls and adorned with a floral or leaf-like headdress. The expression on the bust is serene, and the gaze is directed slightly off to one side. The paper on which the drawing is made shows signs of age, with visible yellowish spots scattered across the surface.

artworks.title: Dr. Robert Fludd, Physician and Rosicrucian
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man facing forward with a thoughtful expression. He has a high forehead with receding hair, a pointed nose, and a neat beard and mustache. He wears a ruffled collar and an elaborate garment with buttons. He is holding an object in one hand and his other hand is near a book or pedestal. In the background is a coat of arms within an oval frame, surrounded by Latin text and decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Dr. Robert Fludd, Physician and Rosicrucian
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the right. He has a mustache and pointed beard, with short, combed back hair. He wears an elaborate garment with a wide, lace-trimmed collar. His right hand is visible, fingers splayed across his chest. The background features an ornate frame with inscriptions. Above and to the left of his head, there is a crest emblem and additional inscriptions inside the frame. The portrait is enclosed within a rectangular border with decorative elements and Latin text.

artworks.title: John Forbes
artworks.artist: Jacques Picart I or Jacques Picart II
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing from the waist up. The person is holding a wooden cross in their right hand, with their left hand raised to their chest. They have a serene facial expression with a prominent brow, a long beard, and short, cropped hair with a tonsure style. The individual is dressed in a simple robe with a hood, tied at the waist with a cord or rope that holds a string of beads ending with a cross. In the background, there are mountains and flowering plants adding to the serene atmosphere. The image is bordered by a descriptive text panel at the bottom.

artworks.title: John Foxe, Martyrologist
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing forward in a slightly three-quarter pose. He has a long, pointed beard, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a furrowed brow. He is wearing a fur-lined robe with a high collar and a patterned garment underneath, and a broad-brimmed hat on his head. The background has a textured, crosshatched design.

artworks.title: Fouet
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after Daniel Dumonstier
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He faces the viewer while looking slightly to the left. The man has a defined face with a straight nose, deep-set eyes, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He has dark, wavy hair styled back from his forehead and is dressed in formal attire with a lace ruff collar. The background is an intricately detailed oval frame with surrounding text "SPE SMEA COPTA FOVET" and additional text below the image. Fine line detailing is present outside the oval frame.

artworks.title: Nicolas Abraham de la Framboisiere
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his left. The man has facial features including a high forehead, a long beard, and neatly combed back hair that reveals a receding hairline. He is dressed in a formal garment with a high collar and buttoned front, featuring a light-colored trim or inner lining visible in the center. Around him is an ornate oval frame adorned with leaves and the inscription "NICOLAS ABRAHAM Sr DE LA FRAMBOSTIERE" at the top, and additional text along the sides and bottom mentioning his age and title. Above the oval is a coat of arms. The background is filled with intricate linework, and the engraving includes additional text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Nicolas Abraham de la Framboisiere
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man facing forward with a contemplative expression. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent cheekbones, short receding hair, a mustache, and a pointed beard. The man is dressed in period attire with a buttoned garment and a high collar. The background features an oval frame with inscriptions, with a textured area outside the oval. There are no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: Nicolas Abraham de la Framboisiere
artworks.description: The image portrays a man in historical attire with distinctive facial features, seated and facing slightly to the left. He has an aged appearance, with short wavy hair, a full beard, and a prominent forehead. The man wears a garment with a high, wide collar and a detailed vest or jacket. In the upper left, there is a framed shield design and below the portrait, an ornate inscription plaque. The background is a textured surface that resembles an engraved print.

artworks.title: Francis II, King of France
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after François Clouet
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the shoulders up, set within an oval frame. The person is positioned facing forward, with their head slightly turned to the right. The individual has youthful facial features, characterized by soft contours, large eyes, and a neutral expression. Their hair is covered by an elaborate hat with a feather and decorative elements. The clothing is ornate, including a high collar with fur trim and a richly embellished garment. There is no visible jewelry. The background within the oval frame is textured with lines, creating a sense of depth. Surrounding the portrait is text identifying the subject as "FRANCOIS SECOND ROY DE FRANCE," with additional text in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Francis II, King of France
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length figure of a person standing with one leg raised on a step. The individual is positioned dynamically with an open stance, as one foot is planted on the ground while the other rests on the step, bent at the knee. The person's head is adorned with a voluminous, textured headpiece or hair that curls and frames their face. The facial features are finely etched, showing defined eyes, a prominent nose, and pursed lips. Their clothing consists of a draped garment that covers the body loosely, with one arm partially visible. The fabric folds elegantly, creating a sense of movement. The background is a plain surface, with subtle lines suggesting depth, and there are shadows present that emphasize the figure's form. The image is a detailed engraving, capturing intricate lines and textures.

artworks.title: Franciscus Guilielmus
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body facing slightly left. He has distinct facial features, wavy hair, and wears a skullcap. The man is dressed in a richly decorated garment with a large collar and buttons. The background features a large circular frame with radiating lines.

artworks.title: Frederick I, Duke of Wurtemberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He has a beard, mustache, and short, curly hair. He is wearing an ornate coat, ruffled collar, cuffs, stockings, and elaborate footwear. He has an ornate chain around his neck and holds a staff in his right hand. The background includes draped fabric, a classical pillar, and a section of cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Fredericus IIII (Frederick IV)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter view portrait. He has a full beard, mustache, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The man is dressed in 16th or 17th-century attire, with a high-collared shirt, lace ruffle, and patterned doublet. The background features an oval frame with etched text.

artworks.title: Frederick IV, Elector Palatine
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait. He is positioned slightly to the side but facing the viewer. The man has a notable nose, strong cheekbones, a groomed mustache, and neat hair. He wears noble clothing with intricate embroidery, a fur-lined cloak, and a sash across his chest. The portrait is framed with classical decorations including a lion crest, shields, figures, and foliage. The inscription below identifies him as "Friedrich IV, Elector Palatine."

artworks.title: Frederick IV, Elector Palatine
artworks.description: The image displays the upper torso of a man facing slightly left. He has a long, pointed beard and mustache, expressive eyes, curly shoulder-length hair, and a solemn expression. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a detailed coat with a high collar, lace, trim, and buttons. A structured garment or cloak is draped over his shoulders. The background features textured patterns within an oval frame containing inscriptions and lettering, with additional intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Frederick IV
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing with his torso slightly turned and his legs apart. His face is forward with a composed expression, and he has prominent facial features including a high forehead. He wears a hat with a feather, and his hair is not distinctly visible. The man is dressed in elaborate clothing featuring an ornately patterned coat with a large collar, a detailed doublet, and hose. He is holding a small bunch of plants in one hand and wears a necklace. Beside him is a lion, lying down with its head up. The background includes a tiled floor, a coat of arms in the upper right corner, and text surrounding the figure, with a decorative border enclosing the entire scene.
